## Patient: David

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:** Mr. David presents with an acute ischemic stroke of the left major arcuate artery (MCA) territory. He reports experiencing sudden onset of severe headache and difficulty speaking.  He exhibits restricted diffusion, a characteristic neurological finding suggestive of MCA infarction.  Aphasia is present, impacting his ability to articulate coherent sentences. Carotid stenosis is noted on examination.

**Physical Exam:** Vital signs stable. Neurological exam reveals slurred speech, weakness in the left arm, and difficulty with comprehension. Facial droop is present.  Motor assessment shows diminished strength in the affected limb.

**Management Plan:** Initiated intravenous thrombolysis (IV tPA) immediately following presentation.
